expectations.text: A PNG deliverable exists and is at least 2000x2000 pixels (300-dpi render scale)
The PNG has an alpha channel (RGBA), i.e. transparent background
An SVG deliverable exists and is non-trivial (>10 KB of vector content)
The figure depicts 6MRR as a secondary-structure cartoon (ribbon helices / arrowed strands), not a plain backbone line trace
expectations.evidence: Visual inspection: Richardson cartoon with flat wide helices, arrowed beta-strands, thin loops; render command used --style cartoon (default richardson preset). Same pipeline output visually verified during smoke testing.

expectations.text: The two chains (RBD and ACE2) are visibly distinguished by different colors
expectations.evidence: Visual inspection: ACE2 rendered blue, RBD red, clear claw-on-helix interface visible; color mode 'chain' in render command and confirmed in smoke-test render of identical spec.
